prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: country learning postcard for Bolivia
Primary request: The historic City of Potosí with recognizable Cerro Rico rising behind the old town.
Subject: Warm colonial and Andean Baroque old-town architecture, modest pale-stone church bell towers, ochre and white facades, terracotta roofs and a cobbled street or small square; the large rust-brown conical Cerro Rico mountain clearly behind the town.
Scene/backdrop: Believable dry high-altitude Bolivian Andean setting, sparse sturdy greenery and brown surrounding hills beneath a vivid blue sky. Cerro Rico is an eroded mining mountain, not a snow-covered volcano.
Style/medium: Cheerful detailed children's-book travel illustration, painterly gouache and digital watercolour with visible brush texture, believable town and mountain geometry, gentle saturated teal, ochre, green and coral.
Composition/framing: One landscape 3:2 image, intended 1536x1024. Wide scenic view along the old-town street toward Cerro Rico; mountain profile and important architecture safely inside central 75% width and height with generous breathing room.
Lighting/mood: Warm natural daylight, welcoming.
Constraints: Stylized educational illustration. No text or letters, UI, flags, logos, watermark, postcard frame or stamp. No tropical palms, jungle, ocean, snowy Fuji-like volcano, unrelated landmark or invented geography.
inspection: Inspected: ochre and white colonial facades, wooden balconies, cobbles, modest Andean Baroque stone bell towers and terracotta roofs with rust-brown Cerro Rico behind. Dry highland setting without palms, sea or a snowy volcano. Street architecture is illustrative rather than an exact street reproduction. No readable text, flags, UI or logos; contain sizing preserves the mountain peak.
